title: Remember butterflies?
old_caption: Cancer remembers when one folded note with a yes box did all this. Then swiping in its sleep, then one mystery card, and the butterflies came back. Remember yours?

title: Atlanta: a city in a forest
old_caption: Taurus in Atlanta: a hundred trees, all tall, none of them text back. Pisces is hugging one and crying. Then a Virgo rolls in and says it texts back, btw. Iconic.

title: Austin: everyone's 'in a band'
old_caption: Gemini is in a band. Gemini is also kinda between things. The stars would like everyone to know that between things is not a genre. Which sign is your 'we'll see' friend?

title: Chicago winter
old_caption: Aries is so frozen it's snuggling a dibs chair, until the wind takes the chair and a warm Leo strolls in. The sign flips to TAKEN. Chicago, who's keeping you warm this winter?

title: Dallas: big expectations
old_caption: Leo's type: tall, rich, owns a ranch. The list got longer than I-35 and the hair got bigger every beat. Then a Sag rolled in. Whose list needs trimming?

title: LA: everyone's photo is perfect.
old_caption: Golden hour, palm trees, glow, one more filter, one more, and the photo is pure white glare. Libra, we can't even see them. What's the most filters you've ever stacked?

title: Miami: 'just visiting'
old_caption: Two nights, one night, a four-hour layover, and Taurus goes heart-eyed anyway. Then Cancer rolls up with no suitcase and an offer of breakfast. Which sign is always just visiting?

title: Nashville heartbreak
old_caption: Pisces is on verse nine of left on read, the heart note just cracked in half, and the stars are not letting verse ten happen. Then Scorpio slides in for a duet. What would your breakup song be called?

title: New Orleans reads your cards
old_caption: The New Orleans card reader sees love. Soon. Probably. The stars, deadpan, point out that cards never say who. Scorpio was impressed by the questions, though.

title: Millions of people in New York…
old_caption: Millions of people in the city, and the same five keep riding past. Now in sunglasses and mustaches. The stars want a new deck, no reruns. Who's the regular you keep seeing everywhere?
